Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 tek Stadiumi Air Albania!
Apartamenti ka nje siperfaqe totale prej 160m2 nga te cilat 140m2 jane pjese e siperfaqes se brendshme dhe 20m2 jane pjese e siperfaqes se perbashket.
Organizohet ne nje sallon ndenje, kuzhine e vecuar, 2 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete, lavanderi dhe nje ballkon me hapesire te konsiderueshme. I mobiluar me nje stil klasik e ndikime vintage dhe i vendosur ne nje nga zonat premium te kryeqytetit.
Ky apartament nuk eshte thjeshte nje hapesire banimi, por nje stil jetese dhe nje investim i sigurt
Lehtesisht i konvertueshem ne 3+1.
Per me shume informacion apo nje vizite ne prone, na kontaktoni!
description_en: 2+1+2 Apartment for sale near Air Albania Stadium! The apartment has a total surface of 160m2, of which 140m2 are part of the internal surface and 20m2 are part of the common surface. It is organized in a living room, separate kitchen, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, laundry and a balcony with considerable space. Furnished with a classic style and vintage influences and located in one of the premium areas of the capital. This apartment is not just a living space, but a lifestyle and a safe investment. Easily convertible to 3+1. For more information or a visit to the property, contact us!
